deviations: SCR-122 mid-edit is UD-3's role change alone (manager → viewer, unsaved; L386): the SH-1 row names no edit (§4 L181), and UD-3's cap error and '1 field needs attention' are board 44's (its {n} % cap is not in §1).
Focus is drawn on the Role select, the edit in progress (the board's reading of 'mid-edit'); the band and its pill hold no focusable control (§4 L199).
The strip reads strip.none: §1's worked example needs no owner action (OV-2, L275, draws strip.none for the same data); the SH-1 row names no strip item.
SCR-122's PageHeader has no primary action: §8 names none (§4's anatomy has the slot).

Identity is read-only text rows (Username, E-mail, Display name, Last sign-in): §8 L405 starts SCR-122's Tab order at Role; the labels are SCR-123's (L415-416) and SCR-121's (L301), as §8 names the fieldset, not its fields.

The Danger zone's buttons follow the Tab order (§8 L405-406; §13 L585): Reset two-factor, Disable, Delete; §8 L361 lists them 'Disable, Delete, Reset two-factor'. Each takes the kit's destructive look (D02:129).
The env badge follows the account name, as unbind.lead's '{account} [{ENV}]' (§14 L610) and the strip's items do; UD-2's prose (L385) puts [LIVE] after sub_001's profile.

Grant rows (CMP-105 composition): the tick, the account and its env badge, the level select and the default profile's link; no column labels (the spec gives none). Selects, the tick and the FormSection cards are token compositions (the kit's 'compose' deviation).
The Save bar is a raised card at the page's end, not sticky (§8 names no sticky bar): below the fold at 1280, in view at 2560.
ud.demotion sits under the select in type.ui.caption, color.text.secondary (the kit's description style, as button(described=)); no source gives its type.
A live countdown (band badge, grace line, view-as banner) sets its clock in type.num.base as its own text node (D02:120; Appendix A L865 CMP-087 Tokens); the node's note carries the full §14 string.

SCR-122 values the spec does not give for alex (the e-mail, display name and last sign-in, sub_002's environment, the five effective-permission inputs per account, the limits, the session row's device, IP and times, the three audit rows, and the audited-read marker under them, whose label §14 does not give) are neutral placeholders: color.surface.hover bars, radius.control (pills radius.badge), the kit's placeholder look; boards 43 (UD-2), 55, 56, 97 and 100 draw that content. They are not a loading state (UD-1 is board 42).

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

A focus ring is a 2 px color.focus.ring inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs (4 px) padding, so it sits 2 px off the control (CMP-039) inside the wrapper's bounds; its radius is the next step (radius.card around radius.control); the wrapper adds 4 px on each side to the layout.

The profile links (CMP-021, two per frame) are underlined: a drawn 1 px color.text.link rect under the text, as wide as the estimated text (cvsheet v1 texts take no textDecoration, and e42kit's link() draws none). Colour alone would not carry them: color.text.link against the color.text.primary beside it is 2.16:1 (dark #6EA1F5 vs #E8EAED, token-sync), under the 3:1 a colour-only link cue needs, and board 01 gets greyscale and deuteranopia renders (§0 L72-73). They are the board's only links, so the kit's 'colour + position only' link line is dropped from these notes.

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes); the chrome binds color.surface.app with color.border.subtle dividers (no source names a chrome surface).
Board names carry Penpot's normalised ' / ' form (E42-D03 / 31 SCR-121 / populated · …) so cvsheet's find-or-create root matches on every section call; §0 L46-47 writes 'SCR-121/populated'.
